title: DecisionProvider interface + MockDecisionProvider + ClaudeDecisionProvider (Anthropic SDK)
acceptance: packages/runner/src/decide/decision-provider.ts: DecisionProvider interface taking { observation, persona, task, recentHistory } → AgentAction
MockDecisionProvider: deterministic action plan from a fixture; used in tests
ClaudeDecisionProvider: calls Anthropic SDK with claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 by default; injects PersonaUXProfile.promptBlock; parses model output into AgentAction (Zod-validated)
Anthropic API key from process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; missing key → throws PERSONA_RUNTIME_KEY_MISSING (graceful, not silent)
Tests: MockDecisionProvider drives a 5-step plan; ClaudeDecisionProvider unit test mocks the SDK and verifies prompt assembly + action parsing
